features.name: age_scaled
features.description: Standardized age feature to provide a smooth normalized score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves convergence and margin optimization in linear models by centering and scaling the age distribution.

features.name: balance_salary_ratio
features.description: Ratio of account balance to estimated salary, clipped to handle extreme outliers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of financial concentration, clipped to prevent extreme outliers from distorting the linear margin.

features.name: credit_score_scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures the credit score contributes proportionally to the SVM margin without dominating due to its large raw magnitude.

features.name: activity_product_interaction
features.description: Interaction term between active member status and the number of products.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a weighted composite of engagement, scaling the number of products by the active status to highlight highly engaged users.

features.name: tenure_scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Scales the tenure feature to a [0, 1] range, ensuring smooth linear projections.

features.name: wealth_age_ratio
features.description: Ratio of balance to age, representing a proxy for wealth accumulation rate.
features.expected_model_benefit: Represents wealth accumulation rate as a continuous ratio, offering a distinct financial metric for the linear model.

features.name: product_utilization_scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes the discrete product count into a smooth [0, 1] score, ideal for linear SVM feature scaling.

features.name: germany_female_segment
features.description: Binary interaction feature identifying female customers from Germany.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a specific demographic intersection as a linear projection, allowing the SVM to assign a distinct weight to this subgroup.

features.name: balance_credit_ratio
features.description: Ratio of balance to credit score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines balance and credit score into a single continuous ratio, providing a proxy for credit utilization.

features.name: salary_scaled
features.expected_model_benefit: Centers and scales the salary distribution, preventing it from overwhelming other features in the SVM margin calculation.

features.name: financial_engagement_index
features.description: Semantic assessment of the customer's overall financial engagement level, synthesizing their balance, salary, and product holdings into a single continuous score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, expert-like evaluation of financial involvement that a linear model can use as a strong, monotonic predictor.

features.name: demographic_retention_score
features.description: Semantic evaluation of the customer's demographic profile (age, geography, gender) and its typical association with long-term account retention.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encapsulates complex demographic interactions into a single continuous severity measure, simplifying the linear projection for the SVM.
